demo.title: bruno-launch-quickstart.sh
demo.code:
npm install -g bruno-launch

# BANKR_API_KEY is read from your existing `bankr login` session
bruno-launch --platform o1exchange --name "Popo" --symbol POPO --description "the frog"

# pools.fun and Pons need a free Pinata key to host the image/metadata
export PINATA_JWT=eyJ...
bruno-launch --platform poolsfun --name "Popo" --symbol POPO --image ./logo.png

setup: Make sure `bankr login` has already been run (BANKR_API_KEY is read from that session)
For pools.fun or Pons only: export PINATA_JWT (free key at https://app.pinata.cloud/developers/api-keys)
